goal: Add the Sauce Labs Bike Light to the cart and open the cart page, so that the cart lists the Sauce Labs Bike Light.
notes: Every product card has its own Add to cart button; use the one in the Sauce Labs Bike Light card. The cart icon in the top-right corner opens the cart.

checks.cart_has_one_item: The cart icon in the header shows the badge 1

bike_light_in_cart.when: The page heading says 'Your Cart' and the only item listed is Sauce Labs Bike Light

other_item_in_cart.when: The page heading says 'Your Cart' and it lists a product that is not the Sauce Labs Bike Light
other_item_in_cart.note: the wrong product was added: check which Add to cart button was clicked (are the buttons distinguishable in the element table?)

empty_cart.when: The page heading says 'Your Cart' and no product is listed
